conditional.title: Conditional Agents
conditional.description: These special agents control pipeline flow — branching, looping, and human review. Add them via the Pipeline Configurator in your project.
conditional.ifGateDesc: Routes pipeline to different agents based on output keywords. The agent writes a full analysis, then puts the routing keyword on the last line.
conditional.whileLoopDesc: Repeats a section until quality passes. The agent writes a full assessment, then puts "retry" or "pass" on the last line. Max iterations configurable.
conditional.humanReviewDesc: Pauses the pipeline for human approval. The user sees the output, then clicks Approve, Reject, or Modify with instructions.
